common_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent high-resolution 2D game-sprite character MASTER, not an animation sheet.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is original native Heroes III artwork enlarged without repainting. It is authoritative for THIS creature's identity, exact idle/ready pose, facing, proportions, costume silhouette, equipment, material colours and distinctive details. Image2 is the source animation-detail board, supporting equipment/anatomy only; do NOT copy its multiple characters or action poses. Image3 is the APPROVED newly painted Pikeman master and defines rendering finish, upper-left lighting, finely modeled volumes, readable edge treatment and small-game-scale clarity ONLY. Do not turn this creature into Pikeman or copy his helmet, crest, weapon or clothing where absent in image1.
PRIMARY REQUEST: Repaint the ONE figure in image1 into a more finely resolved master with the rendering language of image3, preserving image1's recognizable original design. Same three-quarter side-view facing screen RIGHT, same planted idle pose and weapon carriage as image1. Full subject and every weapon tip, limb, wing, hoof and tail completely visible, comfortable transparent margins. Render compact and anatomically credible rather than a portrait.
FINISH: lightly textured modeled game illustration, restrained material base colours, concentrated highlights, coherent anatomy, subtly shaded cloth/leather/metal/feathers, controlled dark edges matching approved Pikeman. NOT blocky enlarged pixel clusters, photoreal photo, glossy toy, 3D plastic, anime, vector or flat cartoon. Source low-resolution details can be clarified without adding elaborate new regalia or redesigning silhouette.
OUTPUT: exactly ONE complete subject (mount+rider counts as one unit when applicable), genuine transparent RGBA, no background, floor, cast ground shadow, pedestal, glow haze, scenery, HUD, words, labels, numbers, title, border, watermark or extra alternate figure. Creature cast/self shading remains, ground shadow does not. No cropped extremities.

creatures.halberdier: A human infantry HALBERDIER, NOT Pikeman. Keep his original simple brown/dark metal helmet, blue-and-gold striped cloth sleeves/trousers, white-blue chest panel, silver shoulder protection, brown leather belt/boots. Hold the distinctive upright WOODEN HALBERD in the exact original grip. Its large bright silver AXE BLADE projects to the right with a narrow spear tip above and a dark red binding/tassel below the metal head. Preserve the axe-head silhouette rather than substituting the Pikeman spear. No shield, sword, cape or new plume.
creatures.archer: A human ARCHER, preserving the original broad dark brown brimmed archer's hat and white padded mail/cloth neck coif, royal-blue short-sleeved tunic with small white heraldic motif, white fitted leggings visible at thighs/knees, brown tall boots and belt. Bare forearms. Same hands-at-waist idle pose with his small WOODEN CROSSBOW held low, and its source-visible carried gear. Source details show horizontal crossbow shooting and a short backup blade; do not put a sword in his idle hand or replace the crossbow by a tall longbow. No heavy plate armor or silver full helmet. He must remain visibly lighter than Marksman.
creatures.marksman: A human MARKSMAN upgraded from Archer. Keep source's dark pointed metal helmet and dark steel CHAINMAIL COIF covering neck/shoulders, blue tunic/long blue cloth panels with white crest accent, white thigh/knee cloth, brown tall boots and belt. Same low-held wooden CROSSBOW and idle hand placement as source. Preserve the original visibly more protected head/neck than Archer, NOT his broad brimmed hat or white neck coif. No large plate breastplate, shield, oversized fantasy crossbow or new cape.

phase: masters only; approval before any animation
